column1: # testrunner-env-known.tsv - tests that fail on a tools/testrunner provider
# because of that provider's environment, not because of the code. When
# EVERY failing test of a unit is listed here for the provider the unit ran
# on, the unit ends env_known: shown in the summary, recorded in the ledger,
# not counted as a gate failure (and not rerun by --rerun-failed). A unit
# with one failing test that is not listed is a plain fail. CI does not read
# this file; known-red.txt is the list for the local merge gates.
# Columns (tab separated; '#' lines and blank lines are ignored):
#   provider   a provider name (modal, dockersbx, local, ssh:<host>) or *
#   package    module-relative package path
#   test       top-level test name, or a prefix ending in *
#   reason     why the environment fails it
# Add a row only for a failure that is the environment's, with the reason;
# remove it when the environment or the test changes and it passes.
